verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs say install scripts do not run for arbitrary dependencies and that you approve which packages may run build scripts. A community comment confirms a `minimumReleaseAge` setting exists in the workspace file, and `pnpm audit` adds registry signature verification. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the `minimumReleaseAge` setting (evidenced only by a community comment), and detailed configuration docs for the build-script allowlist beyond homepage marketing copy.
